app.name: WAKARU
app.tagline: Make the page you're reading make sense.

nav.deleteProjectBody: Permanently delete "{{name}}". This can't be undone.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Jump to a project, source or tab…

home.title: Projects
home.devHint: This screen runs inside the Tauri app. Start it with `npm run tauri dev`.

empty.title: No projects yet
empty.body: A project is where your sources live. Once you make one, drop in PDFs, images, audio and more.

sources.title: Sources
sources.drop: Drop files here, or use Add
sources.empty: No sources yet. Supported: PDF, images, audio, video, spreadsheets, text, Markdown, JSON, code, web links.
sources.unsupported: This format isn't supported. Convert it (e.g. to PDF) and add it again.
sources.linkHint: An http(s) URL. The readable text is extracted and saved.

fileModifier.title: File Modifier
fileModifier.subtitle: One-off conversions that don't belong to a project.
fileModifier.imagesEmpty: Add several images, reorder them, and combine into a PDF.
fileModifier.overwrite: A file with that name exists. Overwrite?
fileModifier.willOrganise: "Organise" structures it with AI — it does not summarise.
fileModifier.shrunkWarn: Under 70% of the original. Markdown saving is blocked; check the diff or save the original as TXT.

search.title: Search
search.hint: Search across your ingested sources by keyword or meaning.
search.keywordOnly: Keyword search only — no search model configured

settings.title: Settings
settings.aiResponseHint: Language for explanations and chat — separate from the UI language.
settings.carryOver: Carry over the previous page's conversation
settings.ocrNote: Read text from imported images, and offer OCR for scanned PDFs. The OCR model is downloaded once on first use.

errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.io: Reading or writing a file failed.
errors.offline: This needs a network connection or an AI endpoint set up.
errors.backendUnavailable: Can't reach the backend. Restart the app.
errors.SOURCE_DUPLICATE: That file is already in this project.
errors.AI_AUTH: The API key is wrong or lacks permission.
errors.AI_MODEL_NOT_LOADED: The selected model is stopped in MLXBar. Load it there.
errors.AI_UPSTREAM: The AI endpoint is temporarily not responding.
errors.AI_NETWORK: Can't connect to the AI endpoint.
errors.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: No AI connection is set up.

ai.notConfigured: No AI connection is set up.
ai.modelNotSet: The selected connection has no model set.

ocr.unavailable: Text recognition is unavailable. Check your connection so the OCR model can download, then try again.
ocr.image: This image could not be read for text recognition.

doc.pdfUnavailable: PDF output is not available in this build; a Markdown version was saved instead.

errors.WEBSITE_INVALID: The folder could not be imported as a website.
errors.STUDIO_SITE_INVALID: The site could not be built (check the file set).
errors.STUDIO_REWIND_LOCKED: Finish or stop the active response before editing history.
errors.STUDIO_MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND: The message to edit could not be found.
errors.STUDIO_TRANSLATE_EMPTY: No translatable text in the source.
errors.STUDIO_TRANSLATE_TOO_LARGE: Source is too large. Split it and retry.
errors.STUDIO_TRANSLATE_TRUNCATED: Translation was cut off. Split and retry.
errors.SOURCE_NO_SPACE: Not enough disk space for this file.
errors.SOURCE_NOT_DOWNLOADED: This file is not downloaded yet.
errors.NOTE_NOT_FOUND: The note could not be found.
errors.VISUAL_TOO_LARGE: The figure exceeds the size limit.
errors.VISUAL_FORBIDDEN: The figure uses features not allowed offline.
errors.VISUAL_INVALID_REF: The figure cites an unknown source.
errors.VISUAL_NOT_FOUND: The figure could not be found.
errors.EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: A file exceeds the export limit.

viewer.extractedTextFallback: The original file could not be rendered, so extracted text is shown instead.
viewer.fileTooLarge: This file exceeds the safe preview limit, so extracted text is shown instead.
viewer.ocrDone: Text recognition finished. The pages are now searchable.
viewer.windowedNotice: Large file: showing one window at a time. The original is intact.
viewer.largeOfficeNotice: Large file: showing extracted text by section. Complex layout, embedded media, macros and change history are not reproduced.

ai.noneBody: Add an OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint, including cloud APIs, LM Studio, MLXBar and Ollama.
ai.mlxBarHint: This is MLXBar's default URL. If LAN access and authentication are enabled, enter the connection URL and API token shown by MLXBar. WAKARU's own source retrieval remains available.
ai.modelNotLoaded: The server is reachable, but the selected model is stopped. Load it in MLXBar.
ai.selectModelToTest: Choose a default model before testing the connection.
ai.name: Name
ai.baseUrlHint: Usually ends in …/v1 (WAKARU adds /v1 automatically if you omit it)
ai.keyStored: Stored — type only to change it
ai.unreachableHint: Check the Base URL and port (usually ending in /v1), that the server is running, that no HTTP proxy is intercepting LAN traffic, and — on macOS — that WAKARU is allowed under System Settings › Privacy & Security › Local Network.
ai.saveFailed: Couldn't save this AI connection. Check the name and Base URL.
ai.embeddingNote: No search model set. Semantic search is off; keyword search still works.
ai.modelsNone: Could not list models — type the model id instead.
ai.modelsFailed: Could not fetch the model list
ai.modelsSaveFirst: Save the connection to fetch models

illustrator.openADocument: Open a document to see its explanation.
illustrator.visionOff: No vision: explaining from text only
illustrator.overviewHint: On open, this explains the whole document in plain terms.
illustrator.handoffSuccess: Live explanation handed off to Studio
illustrator.handoffFailed: Could not hand off to Studio

studio.title: Studio
studio.emptyBody: Start a chat to work from this project's sources.
studio.workspaceEmpty: Files the assistant writes appear here.
studio.sendHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
studio.editingFromHere: This will branch the conversation here. History stays intact until you send.
studio.dropFilesHint: Drop files into Studio to copy them into the app and add them to both Sources and the workspace.
studio.approvalBody: The assistant wants to run a tool. Review the arguments below.
studio.summarised_one: {{count}} earlier message condensed to fit the context
studio.summarised_other: {{count}} earlier messages condensed to fit the context
studio.pickConversationBody: Open a conversation from the list, or start a new one. Past conversations stay hidden until you open them.

mcp.transportSupport: Supports stdio and MCP Streamable HTTP. A connection failure is isolated to that server.
mcp.emptyBody: Add a local MCP server to give Studio extra tools.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.presetSearxngHint: A starting point for using SearXNG web search from Studio. Run a SearXNG instance separately with its JSON output format enabled, and point SEARXNG_URL at it. Requires npx (Node.js).
mcp.commandHint: Absolute path or a command name. npx, uvx, node and similar are found automatically in the usual install locations. Started without a shell.
mcp.envHint: One NAME=value per line. Values are kept in the OS keychain, never in plain text.
mcp.urlHint: Use HTTPS, or HTTP on localhost or a private network.
mcp.headersHint: One Header-Name=value per line. Values are kept in the OS keychain.

about.net2: Fetching web links you explicitly added
about.net3: whisper / embedding model downloads (on your action only)

wizard.title: Welcome to WAKARU
wizard.body: A local-first tool for ingesting your own documents, explaining the page you're on, and working from them with citations. Pick a language and theme. You can set up an AI connection any time.

pm.deleteOne: Permanently delete "{{name}}". This can't be undone. Type the project name to confirm.
pm.deleteManyLabel: Permanently delete {{count}} projects. Type the count.
pm.embeddingsNote: Exports don't include embedding vectors — they're recomputed after import.

whisper.intro: Whisper models transcribe audio and video locally. Pick one and download it; larger models are slower but more accurate.
whisper.diskShort: Not enough disk space — needs about {{needed}}, {{free}} free.

notes.conflict: Edited elsewhere — reloaded. Copy your text and retry.

visual.failed: The figure could not be shown.
